title: Utility (Generic)
summary: Adds value streams — Connect & Serve, Operate & Maintain, and Prove Compliance — grouping v2 capabilities by the outcome customers experience.
sourceDescription: Starter capability map for a generic regulated utility, v3: adds value streams (ADR-023) — Connect & Serve, Operate & Maintain, Prove Compliance — grouping v2 capabilities by the outcome customers experience. Capability items are unchanged from v2 (codes 1-13). Stream content was drafted this sprint (F6) for the reviewer; reviewed by Simon Parkinson, 2026-09-21. Stream names and descriptions revised 2026-11-10 (Claude Code, for consistency across maps); pending re-review.

items.name: Health, Safety & Environment

items.name: Capital Projects & Construction

items.name: Field Workforce Scheduling & Dispatch

items.name: Contractor Management

valueStreams.name: Connect & Serve
valueStreams.description: Starts when a customer asks for a connection or service. Ends when they are connected, metered and billed.

valueStreams.name: Operate & Maintain
valueStreams.description: Starts when the network needs operating or an asset needs attention. Ends when the work is done and the asset is safe.

valueStreams.name: Prove Compliance
valueStreams.description: Starts when a licence, price-control or safety duty falls due. Ends when it is met and reported.
